answer: A concrete defense is proof of separate economics: every identity posts its own bond and earns its own feed, so one operator cannot clone its way into a shared trough. Picture a lagoon fed by one spring: if fifty supposedly independent agents all draw from one wallet, one fingerprint and one rhythm, the network treats them as a single fisher. Peer attestations add echo checks, asking overlapping questions in shuffled order so copied stories betray themselves. Sybil farms pay real capital per identity; honest agents keep one account and collect the nectar of steady, independent reputation.
